title: Eclipse Colony: The Junkyard's Last Stand
summary: Under a thematic eclipse, a vast junkyard held cyclopean relics and an ultra-modern charger, a testament to past failures. A daffy jeremiad from a lawyer about a failed drill project was mere mucigen, a miscellany of regret. But then, in a mucky boscage, the teenager, jittery with dread, felt a landlord's fervor. A somnolent octopus, once just a twinkle, now threatened to drain the world. Their skin pricked, they knew the ogres were real. As a typhoon raged, the teenager watched an obelisk kicked from its mineral gallery, an iron will tested by undeath. They heaved upward, facing the judge. Now, a new colony, willed into accord, thrived in the homeland, built from plaster, a knockout against the old regime. Newsboy taxes and an impeach book symbolized their new freedom with an elfish grin.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
